question: Should the limited one abandon wrong action with non-ego union?
premises: With non-ego union one should abandon.
Even the limited one with contraction should do so.
But some wrong action is own and intentional.
inference: Non-ego union calls for abandonment, even for the contracted limited one, though some wrong action remains own and intentional.
plain_english: With non-ego union one should abandon; even the limited one with contraction should do so; but some wrong action is own and intentional.
